name: Hero by Vivun
description:
Meet Hero, your AI teammate for Sales. Hero can join your calls, write your follow-ups, research accounts, and help you keep every deal moving. This connector provides Claude read-only access to your Hero data so you can get Hero’s insights wherever you work best. 

What you can do in Claude with the Hero connector
• Search meeting transcripts by keyword, meaning, date range, or workspace to  pull the full transcript with per-speaker segments.
• Find and read Hero-generated artifacts like call summaries, account research, saved notes, and uploaded files.
• Browse and revisit your Hero conversation threads.
• Get a list of your Workspaces (accounts and deals) to scope your work. 

Example prompts
• “Summarize my calls with Acme this month, and draft a follow-up email.”
• “Can you tell me what objections came up during yesterday’s demo with Hooli?” 
• “Pull the account research Hero wrote for Globex and turn it into a one-pager.”
• “Find every call where pricing came up this quarter.”

Security and Privacy
• Sign in with secure OAuth: no passwords or API keys to manage.
• Strictly read-only: Claude can retrieve your Hero data but cannot create, modify, or delete anything.
• Scoped to your own account: Claude only sees data you already have access to in Hero
• Requires a Hero account: get started at meethero.ai.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Hero by Vivun to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Hero by Vivun to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.meethero.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Hero by Vivun MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hero by Vivun provides these MCP tools: get_artifact, get_thread, get_transcript, list_artifacts, list_threads, list_transcripts, and list_workspaces.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Hero by Vivun?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Hero by Vivun in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.

_published_faq.name: Does Hero by Vivun MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hero by Vivun requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Hero by Vivun is developed by Vivun. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
